definitions.gloss: feeling of fullness; sense of being full; satiety
definitions.explanation: The physical sensation of having eaten enough. Commonly discussed in the context of diet, health, and food.

examples.japanese: {満腹感|まんぷくかん}が{得|え}られた。
よく{噛|か}んで{食|た}べると{満腹感|まんぷくかん}を{感|かん}じやすい。
examples.english: If you chew your food well, you feel full more easily.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}はカロリーが{低|ひく}いのに{満腹感|まんぷくかん}がある。
examples.english: This dish is low in calories but still filling.

notes:
Compound of {満腹|まんぷく} (full stomach) + {感|かん} (feeling, sense). Frequently used in health and diet contexts when discussing how foods affect appetite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}を{得|え}る: to feel full, to achieve satiety
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}を{感|かん}じる: to sense fullness
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}がある: to be filling
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}が{続|つづ}く: fullness lasts
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}が{少|すく}ない: not very filling

RELATED WORDS:
- {満腹|まんぷく}: full (stomach) — the base word describing the state itself
- {空腹感|くうふくかん}: feeling of hunger — the opposite sensation
- {腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}: eating until 80% full — a traditional health guideline
